title: Sennacherib's Demands and Hezekiah's Payment
description: The king of Assyria, Sennacherib, captures the fortified cities of Judah. Hezekiah sends a message to Lachish, acknowledges his sin, and asks for peace. He pays three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold, taking them from the house of the Lord and the royal treasuries, and even strips the gold from the temple doors.
